title: Responsive Spacing and Dimensions knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Responsive Spacing and Dimensions?
options: It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
choose utilities that express the intended layout, constraints and responsive changes
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
questions.answer_key: choose utilities that express the intended layout, constraints and responsive changes
questions.explanation: Responsive Spacing and Dimensions is best understood through the syllabus topics: Adjusting padding for small screens, Changing container widths at breakpoints, Responsive section spacing. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with responsive spacing and dimensions?
options: test a narrow viewport, a wide viewport and overflowing content
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
questions.answer_key: test a narrow viewport, a wide viewport and overflowing content
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Adjusting padding for small screens, Changing container widths at breakpoints, Responsive section spacing, Managing dense mobile layouts.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying responsive spacing and dimensions?
options: Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a desktop-only screenshot is not enough evidence of a responsive layout
questions.answer_key: a desktop-only screenshot is not enough evidence of a responsive layout
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
